assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as an AI concept submission, but statutory controls and exact spatial placement still need official data and professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints and are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Area, ratio, land-use partition, road, building, green-space, public-space, and phasing metrics must be recalculated after official polygons are received.

assumptions.statement: Tokai, Oskyi, and GPT-image visual layers express spatial actions and atmosphere, not existing conditions, surveying, or approved design.
assumptions.impact: Generated images cannot verify location, scale, boundary, engineering feasibility, or present-day conditions.

assumptions.statement: The node archive intentionally includes locked, unlocked, superseded, rejected, and pending artifacts.
assumptions.impact: Only artifacts named in lock or approval manifests may be treated as concept baselines; all others are comparison or handoff material.
